top_signals.title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
top_signals.summary: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Paramount closes Warner merger in historic Hollywood deal
top_signals.summary: The new company, which will be called Skydance, combines two of the five largest Hollywood film studios.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
